t: Lightweight and robust vacuum for wet and dry use. Ideal for cleaning up dust, debris, sludge or water. Supplied with 5.5m cable, 2.4m hose and 3 extension tubes giving a total reach of over 9m. Easy to store and transport with 4 easy-roll castors. Can be used with or without dust bags. Features stainless steel tank and float shut-off mechanism. Suitable for domestic and commercial use.
